heading: Adeegyada goobtani isticmaali karto
stateAsk: Weli lama dooran: marka hore ayuu weydiinayaa
changedAllow: Waa la keydiyey: {service} waa la oggol yahay.
withdrawn: Dhammaan doorashooyinka waa laga noqday. Adeeg kastaa mar kale ayuu weydiin doonaa.
serviceSends_google_analytics: Wuxuu tiriyaa booqashooyinka iyo boggaga la akhriyey. Google wuxuu helaa cinwaankaaga IP wuxuuna dhigi karaa cookies.
serviceSends_youtube: Wuxuu shidaa fiidiyowyada YouTube. Google wuxuu helaa cinwaankaaga IP wuxuuna dhigi karaa cookies.
serviceSends_vimeo: Wuxuu shidaa fiidiyowyada Vimeo. Vimeo wuxuu helaa cinwaankaaga IP; goobtani waxay ka codsanaysaa inuusan ku raadraacin.
serviceSends_google_maps: Wuxuu muujiyaa khariidado ka yimid Google Maps. Google wuxuu helaa cinwaankaaga IP wuxuuna dhigi karaa cookies.
serviceSends_speech: Marka biraawsarkaagu uusan ku fahmi karin hadalka qalabkaaga, codkaagu wuxuu u socdaa adeeggiisa hadalka (Google, Apple ama Microsoft).
serviceSends_github: Wuxuu muujiyaa kaararka kaydadka koodhka iyo nuxur kale oo ka yimid GitHub. GitHub wuxuu helaa cinwaankaaga IP wuxuuna dhigi karaa cookies.
serviceSends_webstatus: Wuxuu muujiyaa calaamadaha Baseline ee taageerada biraawsarka oo ka yimid webstatus.dev, oo ah mashruuc Google Chrome. Google wuxuu helaa cinwaankaaga IP.
serviceSends_aframe: Wuxuu ka soo raraa maktabadda A-Frame aframe.io si uu u muujiyo muuqaallo 3D ah. aframe.io wuxuu helaa cinwaankaaga IP.
serviceSends_embed: Wuxuu muujiyaa nuxur ka yimid {host}. {host} wuxuu helaa cinwaankaaga IP wuxuuna dhigi karaa cookies.
